name: Revit sparingen (MEP openings)
description: Sparingen: openings where pipes, ducts, conduits and cable trays pass through walls and floors. find (read-only) lists every crossing with MEP size, host thickness, passage angle, an existing opening if any, and a suggested sparing size; links optional. place (write, needs an approved plan) puts a sparing family or native opening at each crossing, sets its size and an approval status, and replaces only the sparingen it made under the same tag. Not yet run against a live Revit.
author: AEC Model Bridge

commands.title: Find where MEP runs (pipes, ducts, conduits, cable trays) pass through walls and floors, also in links, and suggest a sparing per crossing: MEP size plus clearance, rounded up, with host thickness, angle and any existing opening. Read-only and budgeted. For general clashes use revit_check_clashes or revit_check_intersections; for sparingen use this, then revit_sparing_place.

categories.description: MEP categories to check: pipes, ducts, conduits, cabletrays. Default all four.

system.description: Only MEP elements whose system name contains this text (case-insensitive), for example 'Riolering' or 'Supply Air'. Default: every system.

level.description: Only MEP elements whose reference level has exactly this name. Default: every level.

items.description: ElementId of a pipe, duct, conduit or cable tray in the active model.

ids.description: Only these MEP elements of the active model (at most 2000). Links are then not searched for MEP.

host_categories.description: Host categories the MEP may pass through: walls, floors, roofs, structuralframing. Default walls and floors.

include_links.description: Also search loaded linked models, for hosts and for MEP (for example the architect's walls or the structural floors). Link transforms are applied. Default false.

sparing_family.description: Name of the sparing family already used in the models; its instances count as an existing opening at a crossing. Native openings always count. revit_sparing_place uses family_name when this is left out.

clearance_mm.description: Free space around the MEP on every side, added to the outer size (insulation included). Default 25 mm.

round_to_mm.description: The suggested sparing size and depth are rounded up to a multiple of this. Default 10 mm.

merge_tolerance_mm.description: Crossings of the same MEP run (same element, or same system and direction) through the same host closer than this become one sparing. Default 100 mm.

existing_tolerance_mm.description: An existing opening or sparing family within this distance of a crossing centre counts as already there. Default 50 mm.

max_pairs.description: Stop after this many MEP/host pairs whose boxes overlap; the result is then truncated and not verified. Default 20000.

max_elements.description: At most this many MEP elements and this many hosts are read; more makes the result truncated. Default 2000, at most 20000.

time_budget_s.description: Stop the geometry tests after this many seconds so Revit is not blocked longer (1 to 25). Default 15.

limit.description: Rows returned (1 to 500). Default 200; the full list goes to the detail file when cut.

commands.title: Place sparingen at the crossings revit_sparing_find reports: a loaded sparing family or a native opening, sized, with an approval status. Write tool: needs an approved plan, one transaction per sparing, rolls back on failure unless on_error is skip, replaces only what it made under the same tag. Run revit_sparing_find first; dry_run shows the result without keeping it.

tag.description: Your label for this batch, 1-80 ASCII characters, for example 'SPA-L01'. A re-run with the same tag replaces only the sparingen it made; other sparingen are never touched.

mode.description: family: place a loaded sparing family. opening: a native rectangular opening in a wall, floor or roof of the active model (not in a link).

family_name.description: mode family: the loaded sparing family (face-based, work-plane based, wall or floor hosted, or unhosted).

type_name.description: mode family: the type of that family to place.

size_parameters.description: mode family: the instance parameters that get the size, for example {"width": "b", "height": "h", "depth": "d"}; diameter is used for a round crossing when given. Missing parameters stop the call before anything changes and list the ones the family has.

width.description: Length parameter for the width (along the wall, or X in a floor).

height.description: Length parameter for the height (vertical in a wall, or Y in a floor).

depth.description: Length parameter for the depth (host thickness, rounded up).

diameter.description: Length parameter for the diameter of a round sparing.

status_parameter.description: Text instance parameter that holds the approval status, for example 'Sparing status'. Default none: no status is written.

crossing_ids.description: Place only these crossings (crossing_id values from revit_sparing_find with the same filters). Default: every crossing that needs a sparing.

max_sparings.description: Refuse the call when more sparingen would be placed than this (1 to 500). Default 100.

on_error.description: abort: the first failure rolls everything back. skip: keep what worked and list what failed.

dry_run.description: Do all the work, report it with the post-check, then roll everything back. Default false.
